item.title: Moldova and US plan corridor to channel Azerbaijani gas to Europe
item.description: Moldova and the United States are advancing plans to develop a Vertical Gas Corridor capable of transporting Azerbaijani gas across Eastern Europe, Azernews reports.

item.title: Venezuela advances major oil law overhaul to open sector to private and foreign firms
item.description: The Venezuelan government has moved forward with a significant amendment to its oil legislation that would open up the country’s long-state-dominated petroleum sector to private companies, including potential participation by foreign investors, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan becomes Georgia’s second-largest cattle export market in 2025
item.description: In 2025, Georgia exported cattle worth $27 million to Azerbaijan, marking a 2.5-fold increase compared to 2024, according to the National Statistics Office of Georgia, Azernews reports.

item.title: Chinese automaker takes over Nissan’s South African plant, safeguarding jobs
item.description: Chinese automaker Chery has acquired Nissan’s manufacturing assets in Rosslyn, South Africa, including land, buildings, and an adjacent plant, marking a major shift in the local automotive industry, Azernews reports.

item.title: China’s top general under investigation in latest military purge
item.description: The Chinese military’s top general is being investigated for suspected serious violations of discipline and law the Defense Ministry said Saturday, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan-Russia trade edges up in 2025 despite shrinking foreign trade surplus
item.description: In 2025, Azerbaijan’s trade with Russia reached $4.920 billion, marking a 2.5% increase compared to 2024, according to the State Customs Committee, Azernews reports.

item.title: How soaring gas prices reshaping Azerbaijan’s fiscal landscape
item.description: As global energy markets gyrate with seasonal demand and geopolitical recalibration, Azerbaijan’s government finds itself both fortunate and challenged by the natural gas boom of 2025. The latest figures from the State Customs Committee show that the country’s average export price for gas in 2025 reached $350.23 per 1,000 cubic meters, significantly above the $242 assumed in the state budget, illustrating just how swiftly market dynamics can diverge from fiscal planning. item.title: Trump: China will not take over Canada
item.description: United States President Donald Trump claimed on Saturday that "the last thing the world needs is to have China take over Canada," and vowed that it will not happen, Azernews reports.

item.title: Weekly review: Azerbaijani manat holds steady against U.S. dollar
item.description: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan (CBA) kept the official exchange rate of the Azerbaijani manat against the U.S. dollar unchanged this week, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijani Parliament Speaker visits Bahrain for 16th APA Session
item.description: Speaker of the Azerbaijani Parliament, Sahiba Gafarova, has arrived in the Kingdom of Bahrain to participate in the opening of the 16th Plenary Session of the Asian Parliamentary Assembly (APA), Azernews reports citing the Azerbaijani Parliament’s press and public relations department.
